text: E1 requires More to list Indent, Spacing, Page view, Prose check, and Page setup as labelled rows with shortcut hints. Current src/editor/shortcuts.ts has no hint entries for these controls, and T131 does not own that file (N1/K2 own the future shortcut registry/wiring). Should E1 add hints now (please provide the intended shortcuts), or should E1 verify the labels and defer hints to the shortcut tasks? I will not invent bindings.
resolution: Default applied (coordinator, owner said answer with defaults): do not invent bindings. E1 verifies the labelled rows and shows hints only where src/editor/shortcuts.ts already has one; missing hints come from the registry in K2 (T148). Note the deferral in the done note.
